name: V5 creator visual parity gate
required: at least 6 distinct shot compositions in first 30 seconds
at least 3 shot scales: close, medium, wide
primary character occupies at least 20% frame height in reaction shots
at least 4 visible physical interactions with cause-and-effect
no spoken production directions or SFX labels
voice, SFX and music are separate media tracks
reference comparison must be performed on rendered proof frames
full_episode_allowed_only_after: rendered proof passes visual parity review
